name: Dream Team
description: Dream Team keeps houses in Lansdowne comfortable when the weather will not cooperate. Call for a repair, a tune-up, or a system that has had enough.

hero.headline: Heat, air, and a crew that shows up
hero.sub: Dream Team keeps houses in Lansdowne comfortable when the weather will not cooperate. Call for a repair, a tune-up, or a system that has had enough.

story.heading: The truck you wanted yesterday
paragraphs: When the house is too hot or too cold, you want a person who will come over and fix it. That is the job.
We keep the conversation plain: what failed, what it costs, and when we can be there.
Dream Team serves people who live and work in Paoli.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.
Neighbors already know the name. The site should make the first visit easy.

items: Get a window, not a maybe

experience.heading: How a visit goes

feature.heading: Repair first, replace when you must
feature.text: We would rather fix a system that still has life than sell you a new one. If replacement is the honest answer, you will hear why.

spotlight.heading: 436 S. Lansdowne Avenue
spotlight.text: Local houses, local trucks. If you can describe the noise, we can usually guess the part.

contact.heading: Get a tech on the way
contact.sub: Call the number on this page. Tell us the town and what the system is doing.

closing.heading: We will come to the house
